annotations.title: Text-to-speech: English or Spanish MP3 audio (Deepgram Aura-2), safety-screened

description: Use when an agent needs spoken audio from short text (voice reply, narration). English and Spanish only; other languages 400, not charged. Input: text (max 500 chars), lang (en or es; default en). Price: $0.01 up to 200 chars, $0.02 for 201-500. Output: MP3 audio (base64), voice, model, safety verdict. One fixed voice per language, no cloning. Llama Guard 3 screens text; unsafe 422, not charged. Not stored. Example: ?text=Hello%20from%201gateway&lang=en Price: $0.01–$0.02 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

lang.description: Speech language: en (English) or es (Spanish) only; default en. One built-in voice per language. Other languages → 400 (not charged)

text.description: Text to speak (1-500 chars). Empty or longer text → 400 before payment (not charged)
